title: Licensing ambiguity escalation & derivative-weight review flow
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: We continue to see model uploads whose license metadata is incomplete, contains dual/compound licenses, or references non-SPDX terms. Separately, some model artifacts include 'derivative weights' (forks, retrain checkpoints, finetunes) where provenance is incomplete. Current onboarding flow allows publishing performance profiles before human legal review which creates risk for downstream customers.

Goal: Define a deterministic escalation and gating flow that: (1) automatically triages ambiguous licenses with confidence thresholds, (2) quarantines models and marks performance profiles as 'pending compliance' until resolved, (3) surfaces derivative-weight provenance checks, and (4) provides a clear SLA and escalation matrix for Legal + Product + Research reviews.

Scope: Hosted and Dedicated onboarding UI and API, model catalog metadata, performance profile publishing, and internal compliance dashboard. Does NOT include on-prem agent changes (follow-up ticket planned).
acceptance_criteria: Automated license parser runs on upload and returns SPDX id + confidence score
If confidence < 0.85 or dual/unknown licenses detected, model is placed in 'legal-quarantine' and cannot publish performance profile
Derivatives flag computed (based on metadata fields and manifest diff); if derivatives present and provenance missing, quarantine is applied
Quarantine page in Console provides one-click escalate-to-legal with email template and links to artifacts
Legal review outcome options recorded (approve, require-resubmission, reject) and recorded in model metadata
Performance profile publishing API returns 403 with descriptive error when model is quarantined
SLA: initial legal triage within 3 business days after escalation; final decision within 10 business days or automatic hold extension with status update
design_notes: We will reuse the existing quarantine UI from previous restricted-weights flow but add two new states: 'Pending Copyright Clarification' and 'Derivatives Provenance Review'. Design to include copy for customers explaining next steps and expected SLAs. Provide clear CTA for uploading provenance artifacts (license text, model card, training dataset attestation).
engineering_notes: Backend: extend model-ingestion lambda to attach parser confidence and derivatives flag. Add new field 'compliance_status' = {clear,pending_quarantine,legal_hold} stored as string in catalog. API: publish-performance-profile should check compliance_status and return structured error. Create small compliance microservice for escalation workflows and audit log. Instrument metrics: quarantine_count, avg_quarantine_time, legal_decision_latency.
risks_and_tradeoffs: Tight gating reduces risk but increases time-to-market for models and frustrates some partners. False positives from parser (low confidence) will increase manual load on Legal. Trade-off: set conservative confidence threshold initially (0.85) and iterate after 30 days based on false-positive rate. Consider white-listing trusted submitters (enterprise customers) to bypass manual step if their legal team has pre-signed attestation.
test_plan: Create synthetic uploads with known SPDX ids and verify confidence scores
Upload models with compound license strings (e.g., 'Apache-2.0 OR CC-BY-NC') and assert quarantine
Simulate derivative weights without provenance document and verify UI quarantine and escalation flow
Attempt to publish performance profile while quarantined and assert 403 and correct error message
End-to-end legal escalation: escalate, record decision, verify metadata update and release of performance profile
